name: Julie q
text:
I Love a good Dive bar!!!!
This place looks as if its seen better days, like 20yrs ago. Huge stage out back ,seats at least 80 has ping pong ,Beer pong, cornhole, jinga,a few other fun things! Unfortunately the owner either no longer cares or has no money to repair or maintain all these fun cool things the outside bar looks like its not been used in a very LONG TIME😟
Needs a few more lights in certain places.  I couldn't see or read the tap handles ( NEEDS LIGHT ABOVE THEM) hard to see or read the liquor bottles on shelf  Needs lights to display better! Pulltab area could use a few more Neons/lights in that area to draw more play 🤑 No signage for the amazing beer garden. We thought the Exist door was just that, not the entrance to the HUGE outdoor area! 🫠
The food was Really Good & affordable!! We had chicken Ceasar salad with garlic bread & chicken bacon ranch flatbread .
I saw 5 pool tables & 3 being used FREE pool ( Monday night)- LOVE THAT!   Alot of TVs which were showing Hockey play offs & Mariners  which we had stopped in to catch the end of BOTH*
NO POSTERS inside that I saw for Live Band on friday?! We did see it on reader board, So we are going to come back and check that out!! The bartender/server was very nice!
All in all this place is great, just needs more love & upkeep 😃

name: Ryann Haileigh
text:
Chloe is hands down the greatest bartender of all time. I ordered a vodka soda and somehow she fixed my childhood trauma, balanced my checkbook, and negotiated peace between three strangers arguing over a football game.

My drink arrived before I even knew I wanted it. The ice cubes were perfectly educated and the lime wedge had a better personality than most people I’ve met. At one point Chloe shook a cocktail so hard I swear it changed the weather outside.

A customer dropped a glass and Chloe appeared beside it before it hit the floor. Scientists are still studying how she achieved this. The FBI has reportedly opened an investigation into her superhuman reflexes.

Would absolutely recommend. If Chloe isn’t bartending, I simply go home and try again another day.

name: Ken Turner
text: I was meeting a biker friend of mine for a couple of brews. With the WR Bridge closed the Log Cabin is at halfway point between my friends house in Orting and mine in Enumclaw. We didn't order food so I guess that's why the bartender never came out from behind the bar. We had to repeatedly approach the bar to order more drinks; however, She was extra attentive to customers sitting in the pull tab area. They never had to leave their seats for drinks at all. I noticed other customers had to go to the bar for drinks as well. Maybe she's not allowed by management to walk the floor and check to see if we all needed a fresh drink or decided to order food. I guess they should post a sign out that states this is a self service bar. On a positive note the bartender greeted me when I walked in & was pleasant to talk to. Just to clarify our visit took place Friday 08/22/25 and it wasn't busy at all. This must be the norm because I've experienced the same lack of service at other drinking establishments. So sad indeed but I'll give it another try some other time.

This is definitely your one stop shop for drinks food and games! They had like 4 or 5 pool tables a dart board and ski ball!! We will be back!

name: Justin H
text:
***Long review, sorry.***

I used to go here once or twice a week with my friends back in the late 2000s and even for a little while after ownership changed. My friends went to high school/knew the current owner.

Any way it has been several years since i have been here and nostalgia and craving some bar food got the best of me. My friend and I got there around 2:30 I want to say and there was literally only 2 other customers there, a couple. We sat down and were brought menus. It would have been nice had the bartender (friendly gal) had let us know that there were no top sirloin steaks available  at that time as they had run out and were in the process of thawing out some more. Alas she did not mention this until after we had looked over the menu and set our sights on that particular steak, which we had already discussed ordering before going. So we were a little disappointed when she did tell us after we had looked over the menu.

So, we both went for sandwiches. I the prime rib dip and my friend the burger dip. Our orders were in. It was the only food order that I could see the lady in the kitchen preparing, as the 2 other people were playing pool and then drinking. After what seemed like a bit of wait the cute (friendly) lady in the kitchen brought us our orders.

Now even though it was unusually dark inside even for a bar, especially during day light hours, I could tell right away the patty on the burger dip was charred completely on the outside. Granted it was ordered "well done". A blanket of char is a step beyond that! The bread on both sandwiches was burnt on the inside, the au jus tasted like it was sitting in a hot sauce pan for too long, and my tots were overcook. The prime rib meat was bland, no flavor at all.

As we were both starving and not wanting to wait again or drive some where else (also waiting) we decided to just eat half of our food and leave. I really wish either of the two ladies had come over to our table and asked if everything tasted good, but that didn't happen. I went up the the counter, paid, and left. I was still was not asked how everything was. We were not even told thanks for coming, even though the bartender (friendly) was not slammed, with only just a few other patrons who had come in since we had first placed our order.

Sadly I will probably not be back again for several more years, if even ever after this disappointing experience. I miss Keith the cook, and even some of the old bartenders even if they weren't always the most friendly.

Friendly attitude of the staff and a little nostalgic feeling saved this from being a 1 star review.
